newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Rodriguez says jobs grew in March-DyN.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Rodriguez says jobs grew in March-DyN.

text.p: Argentine cabinet chief Jorge Rodriguez said Wednesday that employment rose 0.8 percent in March, according to the private DyN news agency.
Rodriguez was quoted as saying in his bi-monthly address to the Senate that the number of jobs has grown 4.5 percent in the last year.

However, there was no mention of any progress in lowering the unemployment rate, which was last measured in October at 17.1 percent. The government has forecast a reduction in unemployment of about two percentage points this year.
"The trend is beginning to turn around," Rodriguez said. ((--Gary Regenstreif, Buenos Aires newsroom, 541 318-0618))
